messages:
elaine_devex: Quick heads-up — planning to cut client-js v7 on Monday morning. main breaking changes:
- auth: no more plain apiKey string; we now require a tokenProvider callback for automatic refresh.
- retries: default retries = 3 with exp backoff + jitter (config name: retryOptions).
- streaming: switched to event-stream framing (enableEventStream: true) — old chunked streaming is deprecated.
Need: migration guide, short code samples for Node/browser, and a docs PR. Can @ben_sdk or @matt_eng sanity-check the compatibility notes? :wave:

ben_sdk: Thanks for the ping. I opened the release PR draft — calling out the three bullets you mentioned. A couple notes from the SDK side:
- We kept a compatibility shim for the apiKey string for one release but it logs a deprecation warning. It will be removed in v8.
- tokenProvider shape: async () => ({ token, expiresAt }) — we use expiresAt to avoid extra roundtrips.
- Example snippet:
```
// old (v6)
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })

// new (v7)
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  tokenProvider: async () => {
    const token = await fetchRefreshTokenSomehow()
    return { token, expiresAt: Date.now() + 55 * 60 * 1000 }
  }
})
```

matt_eng: Quick runtime notes from infra:
- Private/Dedicated: no change to auth flow if customers use instance-level credentials, but make sure our docs show how to wire KMS/HSM-backed tokenProvider.
- Streaming change: our load tests show a small CPU bump for SSE framing. Recommend enabling keepalive and setting the new streaming timeouts in the runtime (streamingReadTimeoutMs = 120000).

sasha_platform: For platform teams: call out Node runtime support. v7 drops node 12 support and requires native fetch (node 18+). If a customer is on an older base image, they need to polyfill. I'll add a checklist for Dedicated images.

elaine_devex: Good catch about node. I'll add a short migration subsection: Node 12 -> 18+, tokenProvider example, how to opt into the compatibility shim if needed.

ben_sdk: Also FYI about retries — default backoff params can be overridden with:
```
client.updateConfig({ retryOptions: { retries: 0, baseMs: 100, maxMs: 2000 } })
```
We recommend keeping retries enabled for flaky networks, but some streaming endpoints should use retries=0.

matt_eng: Can we document which endpoints to avoid automatic retries on? e.g., streaming generate endpoint should be retries=0 by default.

ben_sdk: yes — in the SDK we set streaming endpoints to no-retry by default. Non-streaming generate + embeddings keep retries on.

elaine_devex: Action items:
- @ben_sdk: finalize release PR and add compatibility-shim note + code snippets (ETA: tonight)
- @matt_eng: verify runtime timeout defaults for streaming and add them to the release notes (ETA: EOD)
- @sasha_platform: add Dedicated image checklist and node requirement to infra migration doc (ETA: tomorrow)
- I'll open the docs PR with migration guide and examples once ben's snippets are in.

ci-bot: CircleCI — client-js-release (draft) build passed ✅ (job 3421)

ben_sdk: LGTM, will push a small tweak to the snippet (switch to expiresAt pattern) and assign reviewers.

elaine_devex: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll also add a deprecation banner to the console docs and email the beta customers later today. :email:

ben_sdk: one small follow-up: please remind integrators to check for thrown errors vs. streamed error events after switching framing — we added a helper parseEventStreamError() in the SDK.

elaine_devex: noted. I'll include that in the migration checklist. Thanks! :thumbsup:
